title: Excellent box of treats, just too big for my dogs. :(
text: I wasn’t a fan of the smell of the treats, but I don’t eat them, my dogs love them! That is what matters the most. I actually do love this box, but I do not like the sizes of the snacks. I have small dogs. 11-14 lbs and they had issues with some of the treats being a little too big. The monster braided bully stick was way too big. My dog looked funny holding it and it wasn’t until she got it unbraided into individual sticks that she could chew them. I actually separated it into a bunch of treats the dogs could eat after that. It would have been better if I had got the little bully stick individually rather than just two giant braided ones. The esophagus braided stick smelled much better, but to me was too long for my dog. It’s almost a meal, more than a snack. Wish they were cut into three or four pieces. Some with the Jerky. My dog absolutely loved them, but I felt as if they could have been cut in half. I tried to break them, but they don’t just bend and tear. Lol just made a mess. And the bully spring I just wish there was more of them. You only get two. Would have liked a couple more compared to the rest of the treats, this was really a small portion. If these were in a better portion size for my small dogs I’d give a better review and actually get this box at least once a month. This was an awesome box my dogs absolutely loved. I just need to find things more their size.
label: neutral
